scope: tutorial functional recognition not independent binding validation

source.citation: Dolton et al. Targeting of multiple tumor-associated antigens by individual T cell receptors during successful cancer immunotherapy. Cell. 2023;186(16):3333-3349.e27.

label_definition: recognition_label=1 denotes experimentally reported cognate functional recognition; recognition_label=0 denotes the tutorial's non-cognate category under the reported assay conditions, not an assertion of zero affinity or absolute non-binding.
sequence_policy: Peptide sequences are copied unchanged from the published enFoldX tutorial input. No sequences are generated or modified. The tutorial's additional peptides.csv entries are not included.

EAAGIGILTV.label_basis: MEL8 and MEL5 recognize the Melan A 10-mer: activation assays and HLA-A*02:01 tetramer staining in Dolton et al., Figures 2C-2E and 3F-3G.

LLLGIGILVL.label_basis: MEL8 and MEL5 recognize the BST2 10-mer: activation assays and HLA-A*02:01 tetramer staining in Dolton et al., Figures 2C-2E and 3F-3G.

NLSALGIFST.label_basis: MEL8 and MEL5 recognize the IMP2 10-mer: activation assays and HLA-A*02:01 tetramer staining in Dolton et al., Figures 2C-2E and 3F-3G.

LLLGIGILV.label_basis: The enFoldX tutorial treats this shorter BST2 9-mer as non-cognate. Dolton et al., Figure S7C-S7F, report poor or absent recognition relative to BST2-10; this assay-specific binary label does not establish zero binding affinity.

LILNIAIFFV.label_basis: Non-cognate peptide in the published enFoldX MEL tutorial. Dolton et al., Figures 2C-2D and 3G, test the MEL8 CANTiGEN candidates and report recognition of MelanA10, BST2-10 and IMP2 rather than the remaining candidates under those assay conditions.
